text: ok this is probably a dumb thing to message about but mum's on nights and my little sister (she's 4) has a temperature, 38.5 on the ear thermometer. I gave her calpol at 8 like mum said on the phone and she's honestly being normal, running round, drinking her juice, talking non stop. she only gets a bit flat when it wears off then she perks up again after the next dose. is that ok or am I meant to be doing something else lol. sorry if this is a waste of time
